versions.changelog:
Initial release of record-keeper.

- Introduces a strict work records archiving standard with 13 closed categories and mandatory templates.
- Standardizes file naming, storage (by month), and metadata requirements for all records.
- Provides reference templates for each category in the references/ directory.
- Includes scripts for vector indexing (embed.py) and status management (status.py), with enforced update and state tracking workflow.
- Enforces a vector-based search workflow using SiliconFlow API, with clear fallback procedures.

Initial release of the "record-keeper" skill, providing a comprehensive work record archiving standard.

- Supports 13 strictly fixed categories for work records, each with unique file naming conventions.
- Organizes all records under records/YYYY-MM/, enforcing per-month archiving.
- Enforces specific templates, file name rules, and directory structures for each record type.
- Integrates mandatory vector indexing (SiliconFlow, BAAI/bge-m3) for retrieval and status tracking, with explicit execution steps after every record change.
- Includes detailed boundary determination guidelines, workflow checklists, and forced execution order for embedding and status scripts.
- Prioritizes vector-based search for record retrieval and enforces strict process rules to maintain database and index consistency.
